decision.summary: A multi-axis transient centered near index 478: strong vertical (U) drop (>10 MAD), smaller eastward (E) uplift (~2 MAD), and subtle northward (N) dip (~1 MAD). U remains offset without reversal in the allowed window (440–515); E shows only partial, non-conclusive recovery. The event lacks a confirmed opposing return on any axis within the context, so status is uncertain. The optional jump at index 475 is inconsistent with the visual onset (which occurs later, ~477–478) and is rejected as misaligned.

intervals.observation: U shows a sharp downward step starting at ~477–478 (drop >10 MAD), sustained through 484 with minor fluctuations; E rises ~2 MAD around same time and begins a partial return from ~482 onward but does not fully recover by 484; N dips ~1 MAD coincident with U drop but lacks clear return structure. Return on U is unobserved within allowed context; E recovery is incomplete and ambiguous. No opposing return observed on U before 515.
